code:
# Recording rule for latency SLI
groups:
  - name: sli-latency
    rules:
      - record: sli:latency:{{service_name}}:good
        expr: |
          sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service="{{service_name}}",le="{{threshold_ms}}e-3"}[5m]))
      - record: sli:latency:{{service_name}}:total
        expr: |
          sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{service="{{service_name}}"}[5m]))
      - record: sli:latency:{{service_name}}:ratio
        expr: sli:latency:{{service_name}}:good / sli:latency:{{service_name}}:total
summary_zh: Prometheus recording rule 算 latency SLI 比例
